change: Day2-Day1 and Day3-Day2, within same-origin raw-count path, one-day spacing
acceleration: Day3-2*Day2+Day1; one second difference per path
scope: Fixed March1-April29 2020 training; May1-28 origins; exploratory retrospective replay
intervals: Pointwise 7-origin moving-block bootstrap, 2000 resamples; all regions resampled together. Only28 origins, conditional on existing model/cohort; not post-selection-adjusted.
interpretation: Difference of daily NEW counts, not cumulative cases. Negative acceleration does not necessarily imply declining cases. No jerk estimate from only3 future points; no outbreak claims.
